name: Yaita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yaita city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead pointing upwards.
history: Municipal flag of Yaita, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1978; the emblem dates from 1 November 1958.

features.role: Yaita city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead pointing upwards
